purpose: match-level head-to-head tournament results: who faced whom, in which round, and who won (RK9 pairings for official events, Limitless pairings for online tournaments)

fields.name: match_id
fields.description: Primary key; deterministic hash of event/pod/round/table/player-1 for RK9, and of event/phase/round/table/both handles for an online pairing (the platform gives byes and no-shows no table)

fields.name: division
fields.description: Age division the match was played in, e.g. "Masters", "Senior", "Junior"; "Online" for a Limitless online pairing

fields.name: table_number
fields.description: Physical table the match was played at; null for a bye

fields.name: player_id_1
fields.description: Foreign key to tournament_team.player_id for the first player; null when the player has no roster on record

fields.name: team_id_1
fields.description: Foreign key to tournament_team.team_id for the first player; null when unresolved

fields.name: player_id_2
fields.description: Foreign key to tournament_team.player_id for the second player; null for a bye or when unresolved

fields.name: team_id_2
fields.description: Foreign key to tournament_team.team_id for the second player; null for a bye or when unresolved

fields.name: winner_team_id
fields.description: Foreign key to tournament_team.team_id for the winning side; null for a tie, a bye, or an unresolved winner

fields.name: outcome
fields.description: player1_win | player2_win | tie | bye, derived from RK9's winner/loser cell markup or the online platform's winner field; online pairings can also be no_result (the platform recorded none)

fields.name: is_complete
fields.description: Whether the match has a result: RK9 marks an in-progress round false, and an online no_result pairing is false

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: Provenance: the exact pairings round URL this row was read from

fields.name: extracted_at_utc
fields.description: Provenance: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of the extraction run

fields.name: dataset_version
fields.description: Provenance: dataset version this record was published under
